out=Path(__file__).parent

def request(path,body=None,label='response'):
 req=urllib.request.Request(base+path,data=None if body is None else json.dumps(body).encode(),headers={'Authorization':'Bearer '+os.environ['MCPJAM_API_KEY'],'Content-Type':'application/json','x-mcpjam-launcher':'repeatable-arithmetic-eval'})
 try:
  with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=20) as r: status=r.status; data=json.load(r)
 except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:status=e.code;data=json.load(e)
 record={'status':status,'body':data};(out/(label+'.json')).write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2));print(json.dumps(record));return status,data
if __name__=='__main__':
 status,data=request('/projects/project_fixture/eval-runs',{'suiteId':'suite_fixture','serverIds':['server_fixture']},'launch-'+str(time.time_ns()))
